name: Gavilar Kholin
summary: The late King of Alethkar, brother of Dalinar Kholin, and father of Jasnah and Elhokar. A visionary king who united the warring princedoms of Alethkar under one banner, Gavilar was also a man with dangerous ambitions. His research into the Heralds, his discovery of the true nature of the Knights Radiant, and his desire to become a Herald himself led to his assassination by Szeth on the night he signed a treaty with the Parshendi. Gavilar's death set the events of the Stormlight Archive in motion, but his legacy is far more complex than the heroic king the stories remember: his ambition may have been the catalyst that brought the Desolation itself.
